settings.rotation_minutes.label: Minutes between discoveries
settings.rotation_minutes.description: How often a new fact is presented. Displaying a fact never triggers a download.
settings.difficulty.label: Preferred difficulty
settings.difficulty.description: When set, facts at this level are favoured without removing the rest of the library.
settings.domain.label: Preferred area
settings.domain.description: Favour one area without hiding the others: pure or applied mathematics, algorithms and data structures, computer science, or artificial intelligence.
settings.topics.label: Preferred subjects
settings.topics.description: Subject names such as Number Theory, Graph Theory or Topology. Empty means every subject.
settings.show_explanation.label: Show explanation on the desktop
settings.show_explanation.description: Hide the short explanation for a smaller card. The reader panel always shows it.
settings.card_transparency.label: Card transparency
settings.card_transparency.description: 0% is a solid card; 100% removes the card background. Text stays fully readable at every value.
settings.enable_sources.label: Enable supplementary sources
settings.enable_sources.description: Fetch a small amount of reference metadata from Wikipedia, Quanta Magazine, Math Stack Exchange and arXiv at most once a day. The curated library works fully offline.
settings.source_cadence_hours.label: Source check interval (hours)
settings.source_cadence_hours.descriptio: Minimum time between source checks. Failed checks back off automatically.
settings.catch_up_on_start.label: Catch up after a long absence
settings.catch_up_on_start.description: Rotate once at startup when the interval elapsed while Noctalia was not running.
